mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket (ticket_no, title, content, channel, category_id, priority, status, requester_id, assignee_id, sla_policy_id, respond_deadline, resolve_deadline, create_by) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{channel}, #{categoryId}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{requesterId}, #{assigneeId}, #{slaPolicyId}, #{respondDeadline}, #{resolveDeadline}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_no, title, content, channel, category_id, priority, status, requester_id, assignee_id, sla_policy_id, respond_deadline, resolve_deadline, first_respond_at, resolved_at, closed_at, reopen_count, satisfaction, satisfaction_note, ai_handled, ai_run_id, create_by, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ticket WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, ticket_no, title, content, channel, category_id, priority, status, requester_id, assignee_id, sla_policy_id, respond_deadline, resolve_deadline, first_respond_at, resolved_at, closed_at, reopen_count, satisfaction, satisfaction_note, ai_handled, ai_run_id, create_by, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ticket WHERE ticket_no = #{ticketNo} AND deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.ticket_no, t.title, t.category_id, t.priority, t.status, t.requester_id, t.assignee_id, t.respond_deadline, t.resolve_deadline, t.create_time, t.update_time, c.name AS category_name, ru.name AS requester_name, au.name AS assignee_name, t.content, t.first_respond_at, t.resolved_at, t.closed_at, t.reopen_count FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN ticket_category c ON c.id = t.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = t.requester_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE ticket
title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category_id = #{categoryId}, priority = #{priority}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, satisfaction = #{satisfaction}, satisfaction_note = #{satisfactionNote}, ai_handled = #{aiHandled}, ai_run_id = #{aiRunId}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE ticket
status = #{status}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, closed_at = #{closeAt}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ticket SET resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ticket SET first_respond_at = #{firstRespondAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND first_respond_at IS NULL
UPDATE ticket SET assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ticket SET priority = #{priority}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ticket SET reopen_count = reopen_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ticket SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE ticket_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}

SELECT id, ticket_no, title, content, channel, category_id, priority, status, requester_id, assignee_id, sla_policy_id, respond_deadline, resolve_deadline, first_respond_at, resolved_at, closed_at, reopen_count, satisfaction, satisfaction_note, ai_handled, ai_run_id, create_by, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 4 AND update_time <= #{before}

SELECT id, ticket_no, title, content, channel, category_id, priority, status, requester_id, assignee_id, sla_policy_id, respond_deadline, resolve_deadline, first_respond_at, resolved_at, closed_at, reopen_count, satisfaction, satisfaction_note, ai_handled, ai_run_id, create_by, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 5 AND resolved_at <= #{before}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (5, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN (5, 6) AND resolve_deadline IS NOT NULL AND resolve_deadline < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breachedCount, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, create_time, first_respond_at)), 1) AS avgRespondMinutes FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{from}
